paragraphs.text:
You hear an unearthly crackle. A blast of cold sweeps through 
the  darkness  and  numbs  one  side  of  your  face.  Norman 
scrambles away into the depths of the cave.

To fight it out with the bizarre intruders, go to 380. To bolt from 
the cave and abandon Norman, go to 330.
